title: Implement Touch and Keyboard Input Manager
description: Develop an input management system supporting both HTML5 touch controls (virtual joystick or direct touch drag) and keyboard fallback (arrow keys/WASD and spacebar). Include unit tests verifying input state mapping.
acceptanceCriteria: Touch events correctly translate to normalized directional vectors
Keyboard event listeners update the internal input state immutably
reviewFeedback: The Touch and Keyboard Input Manager implementation is clean, adheres to immutability rules, handles keyboard normalization and pointer events correctly, and is thoroughly tested.
